entries.subject: DAMIT 16304: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 16304, version 2024-04-08, pole (230°, 36°), period 35.984 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 16305 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 124.107 ± 0.857 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 124.107 ± 0.857 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "62.05 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 291 (Masiero et al. 2014) diameter 96.455 ± 1.813 km (NEOWISE, NEATM); the shown value is kept.

entries.subject: Ninina whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 10 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.955 at 462 nm, 1.005 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#363634 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 3.7% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.7%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
